sheets.prompt: Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: low at ground level in an orange desert, a river of flowing rippled sand curves between two tall dunes, sand streaming off their crests in the wind; on its bank a wandering dune has just slid off an old stone doorway with a carved lintel and a stair going down into the dark, sand still pouring off its steps; a sand-sailor on a light board with a striped kite skims past. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack rides a low hoverbike along the sand river, leaning into the curve, a wake of sand behind, for scale. Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a wide establishing view of an orange desert in a strong wind, seen from the top of a mesa in the afternoon: huge crescent dunes with sharp crests march across the plain with long plumes of sand streaming off their tops; between them run rivers of flowing sand, rippled and fast, curving like real rivers; over the edge of a banded mesa pours a slow golden sandfall; one dune has just moved off an old ruin, showing a buried caravan of carts and the top of a tall windcatcher tower; a few sand-sailors in light kite rigs skim along a sand river. Far away a city of white domes round a tall tree. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack stands on the mesa edge in the foreground, tiny against the view.
